caterham.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of Surrey
s1loc: Caterham is well into the Surrey full-fibre rollout, with Openreach pushing fibre to the premises across the town while the alternative networks build alongside. Gigabit coverage now reaches a large share of homes and businesses, and the work runs through the two main parts of the town, Caterham on the Hill and Caterham Valley, out towards Whyteleafe, Chaldon, Warlingham and Woldingham on the edge of the North Downs. The build keeps civils gangs, jointers and fibre engineers working through these districts and the surrounding Tandridge villages, laying duct and pulling fibre to cabinets and customer premises day in and day out.

The commercial scene runs on the town's offices and trading estates. Caterham Valley town centre, the business space along the Godstone Road corridor and the industrial units around Croydon Road host offices, warehousing and light industry that need structured cabling in Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre, plus CCTV and access-control work. The Village shopping area at Caterham on the Hill, schools and a spread of multi-site employers add further network and cabling jobs. Local cabling and security installers wire these businesses across the town, taking on commercial premises and homes alike.
